item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-c573f026b025cf74","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The government cyber authority reported that Bangladesh faced increasingly sophisticated cyber threats in 2023, including targeted phishing against government and law-enforcement entities, a reported 71.39% increase in malware infections, ransomware, DDoS attacks, website defacements, data leaks, and information-stealing malware, and called for robust cybersecurity measures and heightened vigilance.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.10","8B.6","8B.7","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Describes Bangladesh's 2023 threat environment; publication date was 17 October 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The report describes national cyber conditions and institutional risk exposure but does not attribute specific failures or decisions to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["No specific evidence of Hasina's personal directives, funding, enforcement, or corrective actions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-dd0849ee69df2c7c","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"In a June 2023 situational alert, Bangladesh's government cyber authority identified government, military, law-enforcement, banking, pharmaceutical, retail, industrial, energy, and education organizations as targets; identified DDoS, ransomware, web defacement, phishing, credential theft, and APT campaigns; and directed government, military, and financial institutions to conduct continuous monitoring, secure exposed services, and improve password and user-security practices.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.10","5B.3","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Issued 27 June 2023 and directly concerns the 2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"The alert evidences action by a Bangladeshi government cyber authority during Hasina's premiership, but does not show that she personally issued or supervised it.","limitations":["The supplied text does not establish implementation, compliance, funding, outcomes, or independent review."]},{"source_id":"SRC-bb0dd96f0a9668b0","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"At the 5 October 2023 Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant fuel-handover ceremony, Sheikh Hasina joined the event while Vladimir Putin described the plant as contributing to Bangladesh's energy and economic security; the IAEA Director General also participated virtually.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.4","1B.7","1B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Event occurred on 5 October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Hasina's participation demonstrates political support for the nuclear-power project; the supplied report does not establish her safety, safeguards, inspection, or operational decisions.","limitations":["The report provides no evidence on command-and-control, safety performance, safeguards compliance, financing, or accident-prevention implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f864ed5990e54036","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"OHCHR reported that during October 2023 political protests at least 11 people died, including two police officers, six opposition party staff members, and two bystanders; protesters allegedly attacked judicial residences and journalists, while police reportedly used rods, batons, rubber bullets, and sound grenades and raided opposition activists' homes, indiscriminately arresting and detaining hundreds, including family members. OHCHR called for strict necessity, legality, precaution, proportionality, restraint, and full protection of human rights before, during, and after the elections.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.6","2B.9","3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Statement dated 31 October 2023 and concerns protests in the 2023 election period.","ruler_attribution":"The allegations concern police and ruling-party-linked actors under Hasina's government; the supplied statement does not prove her personal orders or knowledge.","limitations":["OHCHR characterized several events as reported or alleged and supplied text contains no subsequent investigation, remedy, or policy correction."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d8b0e642147f90b6","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"OHCHR reported continued legal intimidation and harassment of human-rights advocates and civil-society leaders, including Mohammad Yunus and Odhikar leaders Adilur Rahman Khan and Nasiruddin Elan; it said smear campaigns appeared to emanate from the highest levels of government, Odhikar's licence was not renewed, and the cases raised concerns about fair trial, judicial independence, and civic space. OHCHR also warned that the proposed Cyber Security law retained risks of arbitrary suppression of expression despite replacing imprisonment with fines and expanding bail for some offences.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","4B.9","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Statement dated 5 September 2023 and concerns ongoing conduct during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"OHCHR linked alleged smear campaigns to the highest levels of government but did not establish a personal order by Hasina.","limitations":["The supplied text reports concerns and allegations, not final judicial findings or proof of Hasina's direct involvement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5319cbc4597e6eec","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"In a June 2023 message, Sheikh Hasina stated that the government was implementing social-safety-net and sustainable-development measures for children's security, food, nutrition, shelter, education, and health; reported eight sectors declared child-labour-free, 38 hazardous occupations identified, children withdrawn from hazardous work and offered vocational or technical education, free textbooks distributed, and nearly universal school attendance; and cited child-labour, child-policy, child-protection, child-marriage, domestic-worker, and 2021–2025 action-plan measures.","question_ids":["6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.8","6B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Message issued 11 June 2023; reported programs and policy targets concern the 2023 period and earlier implementation.","ruler_attribution":"The statements and claimed government programs are directly attributed to Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["The source is a government-news account of Hasina's claims; supplied text does not independently verify execution, coverage, incidence, or remaining child labour."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d6f0e52146005e66","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"UNHCR stated that Bangladesh had consistently reaffirmed voluntary and sustainable Rohingya repatriation, while a Bangladesh–Myanmar pilot project considered possible returns; UNHCR said conditions in Myanmar were not conducive to sustainable return, no refugee should be forced to return, and consultation and informed choice were essential. UNHCR also noted Bangladesh's participation in verification efforts and the launch of the 2023 Joint Response Plan, which was 10% funded at the time.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","3B.7","3B.9","6B.3","6B.6","6B.10","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Statement dated 19 March 2023 and concerns the 2023 repatriation initiative and humanitarian response.","ruler_attribution":"UNHCR attributed Bangladesh's stated commitment to voluntary and sustainable repatriation to the government, but did not specifically name Hasina in the supplied text.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether implementation fully protected voluntariness, living conditions, or refugee welfare, and identifies substantial underfunding."]},{"source_id":"SRC-625c566be7f82236","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Bangladesh's Comptroller and Auditor General published audit instructions during 2023, including a financial-audit reporting format on 13 February, further audit instructions on 5 July and 16 July, and a public-financial-statement format on 11 December; the office states that it audits government receipts and public spending and assesses value for money.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7","6B.5","7B.6","7B.7","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The listed instructions were issued during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The documents show the existence and activity of Bangladesh's supreme audit institution during Hasina's premiership, not a specific Hasina decision or response to audit findings.","limitations":["No supplied audit finding, executive response, enforcement action, or evidence of operational independence is provided."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-a255cf67836f0a26","SRC-277fe7c8ae2f2228","SRC-1115094362be3b3f","SRC-07c8996c8d4d6b76"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied documents provide stronger evidence on cyber risk, political repression, child-welfare policy claims, refugee-return safeguards, auditing infrastructure, and nuclear-project support than on economic policy, personal integrity, electoral administration, nuclear safety, arms control, or measurable period-end outcomes.","No scores are assigned."]}
